cases.name: recorded chapter, 2026-10-03
cases.title: Pim and the Sleeping Moon
cases.text:
The moon smiled softly from its chimney tonight. Pim the Turtle was waiting near the roses. Mira watched him all day long.
    The moon whispered secrets of stars, shimmering like snow.
    Pim moved slowly, a tiny, gentle ripple.
    He kept walking past the tall grass, quiet and bright.
    It was warm, and the sun was falling low.
    Mira held her red boots tightly and thought about them.
    Pim continued to walk, a peaceful journey.
    He reached a little patch of shade, soft and green.
    The moon glowed even brighter now.
    Pim stopped, watching a little flower bloom.
    It looked like tiny pearls, all white.
    Mira smiled, and she felt sleepy too.

All the warm, soft things are safe and sleeping now. Good night, little one.
    
Tomorrow's storyteller will tell a sleepy squirrel story.

cases.name: recorded chapter, 2026-10-04
cases.title: Pim and the Moon's Smile
cases.text:
The moon is quiet now, you see.
The moon is a gentle friend, just like you.
Pim the turtle is slow, very slow.
He’s watching the stars, happy and low.
The stars are like tiny lights,
Twinkling softly, quietly.

Pim feels a warm, soft glow,
Like a tiny, sleepy snow.
He walks to the chimney, so near,
Listening to the moon's soft cheer.

A little flower grows slow,
Just like Pim’s gentle flow.
The moon smiles a tiny bit,
Like a small, peaceful fit.
It's cozy and warm tonight,
Shining softly with its light.
Sleepy, sleepy, all dreams,
Safe and warm, it always seems.

$$\close_thread$$

cases.title: The Moon and Pim
cases.text:
The Moon is quiet tonight. It glows softly, watching from the chimney. Pim the Turtle slides along the path. It’s a long, slow walk.  Mira sees a beautiful snow flake.

Pim keeps going. The Moon smiles a tiny bit. They walk past a flower.  It smells fresh and sweet.  Pim feels a little sleepy. Soon, the stars appear, twinkling and bright.

The Moon whispers, 'Sleepy dreams, little one.' Pim smiles and slides into a cozy spot.

Everyone is safe and warm, dreaming softly. They are ready for sleepy time.  {open_thread}  Warm hugs and good dreams follow.

The Moon is quiet. It’s a soft white light.
Pim the Turtle is slow and sleepy.
He sees the snow falling fast.

It’s falling in little flakes.
Each flake is a tiny grey dot.

Pim walks a little.
 He follows each flake.

They go down the hill.
 It makes a happy, quiet sound.

The snow is so soft and white.
Like a fluffy blanket.

Pim smiles, a very gentle smile.
He feels cozy and still.

The Moon shines softly.
It’s like a warm, quiet hug.

Pim starts to drift slowly.
He’s warm and comfy.
He’s already sleepy.

Sleep is coming...

cases.name: recorded chapter, 2026-10-08
cases.title: Pim and The Moon’s Gentle Sleep
cases.text:
The Moon is hiding close to the chimney today. It’s a very quiet friend, and it glows soft and white.

Pim the Turtle is already sleepy. His warm boots are soft and blue.

The Moon is watching Pim. It’s a peaceful sight.
The Moon whispers: "Let the soft snow fall."

Soon, a little bit of snow started to fall. It fell slow, like a dream.
The snowflakes are tiny and sparkly.

Pim the Turtle doesn't move. He just looks at the snow. It looks soft and shiny.

The Moon shines a little bit brighter. It feels cozy.

Pim smiles, feeling warm.
The snow keeps falling softly.

Pim is very quiet now and he feels safe.

The Moon is glowing softly.
A little bit of snow drifts near.

Pim is comfy and sleepy. He's tired.

Pim curls up and closes his eyes. Sleepy, sleepy. The Moon shines too.

The end. Soon everyone will fall asleep.

cases.name: recorded chapter, 2026-10-09
cases.title: Pim and The Moon's Quiet Night
cases.text:
The moon is shining soft tonight, very gently, like tiny sparkles of light. Pim the Turtle is still so, still so slow. He moves a little bit, just watch him.  The moon is a quiet friend, watching from behind the chimney.

The snow is falling softly, just a few little flakes.  Each flake is the size of a small finger.  Pim watches them fall. They go down, down, down to the ground.

The moon smiles a little bit, as if it were happy to see the snow.  Pim stays still with the snow, not moving fast. It feels warm and cozy.

Soon, it's getting late.  It’s time to close your eyes, little one.  You're safe and warm, nestled under your blanket.  Sleepy… sleepy… Very, very sleepy.

Moon and Pim, both sleeping...

cases.name: recorded chapter, 2026-10-10
cases.title: Pim and The Moon’s Sleepy Dream
cases.text:
The moon is sleepy tonight. It’s so small, like a tiny pearl in the sky. Pim the turtle is moving slowly, very, very slow.

It's getting dark and warm, just a little bit.
A little bit of snow is falling, soft and white.

Pim looks at the moon.  The moon smiles gently.

There’s a little leaf in the snow, shiny and brown.
Pim gently touches it.  It feels smooth as silk.

The moon shines brighter even more, watching closely.

Pim keeps moving, and the snow keeps falling down.

The night is quiet and peaceful.

Pim feels sleepy already, a tiny wave of calm.
The moon and Pim are sleeping now.

Sweet dreams, little one.  Sleep tight.

Open thread:  Maybe tomorrow the moon will show Pim a rainbow.
